action.description: list_blobs and read_blob (Blob Storage), peek_messages (Queue Storage, nothing is dequeued), query_entities (Table Storage), list_files and read_file (Azure Files)

account.description: The storage account's resource ID (/subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<group>/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/<name>), or its name

subscription.description: The account's subscription when account is a name; default: the connection's only subscription

container.description: The blob container, such as uploads ($logs and $web too)

blob.description: The blob's full name in the container, such as reports/2026-q3.csv

share.description: The file share, for list_files and read_file

path.description: read_file: the file's path in the share; list_files: a directory (default: the root)

prefix.description: list_blobs: only names that start with it

delimiter.description: list_blobs: groups names into prefixes like folders; "" lists every blob

offset.description: read_blob, read_file: the first byte to read; continue with nextOffset

maxBytes.description: read_blob, read_file: bytes to read (default 65536, lowered to the call's size limit); peek_messages: bytes per message (default 4096, at most 65536)

filter.description: query_entities: an OData filter, such as PartitionKey eq 'orders' and Timestamp ge datetime'2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'

limit.description: list_blobs, list_files, query_entities: items per call (default 50, at most the Cloud policy's Items per call)

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer, with the same arguments
